answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29995 Country: India Title: In 4 rakat namaz if after 2 rakats I start reciting durood after attahiyat by mistake then after realising get up and complete 4 rakats. Is sajdah sahu be done also if not done whether namaz will be right or not? Question: ASSALAMOALAIKUM MUFTI SAHEB IN 4 RAKAT NAMAZ IF AFTER 2 RAKATS I START RECITING DUROOD AFTER ATTAHIYAT BY MISTAKE THEN AFTER REALISING GET UP AND COMPLETE 4 RAKATS IS SAJDAH SAHU BE DONE ALSO IF NOT DONE WHETHER NAMAZ WILL BE RIGHT OR NOT JAZAKALLAH Answer ID: 29995 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 433/235/D=1432) If you have recited up to "اللهم صل على محمد" then sajdah sahv shall be wajib, otherwise not. كما في الدر: فإن زاد عامداً أو ساهياً وجب عليه سجود السهو إذا قال: اللهم صل على محمد على المذهب المفتى به (در مختار مع الشامى: 2/220 ط : زكريا) Nawafil and sunnan ghair muwakkidah are exempted from it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
